headline: Executive order directing federal agencies to manage their energy use more efficiently.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this 1999 order tells federal government agencies to use energy more efficiently in their own operations. It is part of an effort to make government operations more environmentally friendly. No summary was provided, so specific targets, deadlines, and requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to change how they manage and use energy in their operations.
